commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+5' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
90+3' Antony (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guglielmo Vicario, who smothers the ball.
90+1' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Micky van de Ven and he is replaced by Emerson Royal (Tottenham).
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Antony (Manchester United) coming on for Marcus Rashford.
87' Bryan Gil (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
86' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) as his effort only hit the wall. The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
85' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Oliver Skipp is replaced by Radu Dragusin (Tottenham).
84' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) makes a strong challenge and John Brooks blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester Utd.
83' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
83' Richarlison (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tottenham.
80' Substitution. Bryan Gil (Tottenham) replaces Timo Werner.
80' The resulting corner, taken by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), comes to nothing.

79' A lofted cross from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
78' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
78' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
76' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Timo Werner (Tottenham) heads on.
75' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
75' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Andre Onana comes off his line to gather the ball.
74' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Guglielmo Vicario comes off the line to clear the ball away.
72' The game is interrupted as Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is flagged offside.
69' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
69' Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
69' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
69' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Timo Werner (Tottenham) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Tottenham will take a corner kick.
66' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
65' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
65' Richarlison (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
63' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts the ball.
63' Substitution. Jonny Evans leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United).
62' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
61' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

60' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Tottenham force a corner. They send men into the box.
59' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
59' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Scott McTominay (Manchester United) is replacing Christian Eriksen.
58' Timo Werner (Tottenham) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
58' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

58' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
57' Richarlison (Tottenham) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
56' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Tottenham win a corner kick.
55' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Tottenham.
52' Richarlison (Tottenham) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Andre Onana is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
52' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) works the corner short.
51' Timo Werner (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
50' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
49' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
46' 2 - 2 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Timo Werner finds Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the middle of the goal. 2:2.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
45+3' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
45+2' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45+1' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+1' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Timo Werner (Tottenham) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.

43' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.

40' 2 - 1 Goal Marcus Rashford (Manchester United)! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) was put through by Rasmus Hojlund and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 2:1.

35' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Tottenham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
32' The ball is cleared after Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.

32' PENALTY APPEAL after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
31' A dangerous looking corner kick from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is cleared to safety by the defence.
31' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Manchester Utd have a corner.

30' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Andre Onana pulls off an easy save.
27' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
25' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
24' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
24' Timo Werner (Tottenham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
22' Timo Werner (Tottenham) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
19' 1 - 1 Richarlison (Tottenham) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
19' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
19' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
16' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

16' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' The resulting corner from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
14' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
13' Flag up against Brennan Johnson (Tottenham). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
13' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

12' Richarlison (Tottenham) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise. The ball goes out for a corner. Tottenham can continue in their attacking effort.
12' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) meets a cross and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
11' Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.

11' Timo Werner (Tottenham) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant. Tottenham win a corner.

10' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the left side of the goal, but great anticipation by Andre Onana allowed him to make a comfortable save.
8' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
7' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
7' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Corner kick. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity.
6' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

6' Richarlison (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:0.
3' The ball is cleared after Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tries to find Aaron Wan-Bissaka, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Manchester Utd will take the kick-off.
John Brooks will supervise the game today.
